+package main
+

+	"fmt"
+	"log"

+
+// This is a simplified version of the fixed getModuleNameInline function
+func getModuleNameInline(moduleNameKey string, raw json.RawMessage) (string, json.RawMessage, error) {
+	var tmp map[string]any
+	err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &tmp)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", nil, err
+	}
+
+	moduleName, ok := tmp[moduleNameKey].(string)
+	if !ok {
+		// Try to convert to string if it's another type
+		switch v := tmp[moduleNameKey].(type) {

func ParseStructTag(tag string) (map[string]string, error) {
	results := make(map[string]string)
	pairs := strings.Split(tag, " ")
